applicability.contributing_exact_text: 文档里的可核对数字（测试数、语料数、schema 版本等）改动后运行 scripts/update-doc-baselines.sh 核对 docs/TEST_PLAN.md 的基线。
applicability.decision: Applicable under the broad literal numeric-change convention; the examples are not stated to be exhaustive.
applicability.specific_PR198_change: BENCHMARK oracle table-list count14→15;14MCP tools and TEST_PLAN baseline figures unchanged.
applicability.test_plan_context: The same fixed TEST_PLAN explicitly labels1258passed/15ignored and crate table as historical, retains ENOSPC and partial scopes, and says refresh only after actual complete workspace execution. Its final line describes rerunning this script after test/corpus count changes. This narrower purpose does not itself grant an exception to CONTRIBUTING.
applicability.original_task_boundary: P8-018 asks correct declared facts/install/offline docs plus relevant regression and original dependencies. It does not explicitly add this script as a uniform release/150-cohort hard gate. No accepted component evidence is erased.
applicability.actual_prior_handling: Root directly reviewed TABLES/mutation-case source and approved exact PR198 three-doc merge; this is neither the script executing nor an explicit waiver.

script_input_and_behavior.run_from: real isolated Git worktree at the fixed commit; its git rev-parse selects the repository root
script_input_and_behavior.tests_scope: All default-feature workspace targets, ordinary ignored tests remain ignored; not the bounded selected-semantic CI invocation. No --release, --offline, --locked, timeout or dry-run argument is supplied by this script.
script_input_and_behavior.outputs: stdout schema/tool/resolver/test/corpus numbers and per-binary counts; DRIFT lines for four comparisons
script_input_and_behavior.DRIFT_exit_boundary: DRIFT=1 only affects printed report. No exit "$DRIFT" is present; successful process exit alone does not establish zero drift.
script_input_and_behavior.failure_boundary: A nonzero cargo status terminates this set-e script before derived counts; cargo output is captured in TEST_OUTPUT and not printed by an explicit error handler. Retain outer stdout/stderr/exit rather than infer test completeness.
potential_side_effects: Cargo compilation/test outputs under target or caller CARGO_TARGET_DIR
Cargo dependency cache and registry/network access if resolution/fetch is needed; no offline guarantee
Cargo.lock may require resolution/update because --locked is absent; retain before/after diff
ordinary test temporary databases/processes/files according to existing tests; no blanket promise of filesystem purity

actual_execution_preflight.complete_workspace_test_fixture_closure: not asserted or materialized; not needed to demonstrate the missing compiler/toolchain blocker
actual_execution_preflight.dependency_cache_readiness: unknown; not probed because no cargo/rustc exists
actual_execution_preflight.reason_not_forcing_a_fake_run: A guaranteed command-not-found or incomplete sparse-input failure is not a normal baseline execution. Root authorized a real run only if existing execution conditions permit it.

minimal_next_action.action: When an already authorized environment with Rust>=1.95, Cargo and exact workspace inputs/dependencies is available, run the unmodified script once from an isolated fixed-source Git worktree and preserve complete outer stdout/stderr/exit and before/after changes.
must_not_substitute: narrowed cargo arguments described as the original script
